ARG BASE_IMAGE=openeuler/openeuler:24.03
FROM ${BASE_IMAGE} AS python-installer

# Python Environment variables
ENV PATH=/usr/local/python3.12.16/bin:${PATH}

RUN yum update -y && \
    yum install -y \
        gcc \
        gcc-c++ \
        make \
        cmake \
        curl \
        zlib-devel \
        bzip2-devel \
        openssl-devel \
        ncurses-devel \
        sqlite-devel \
        readline-devel \
        tk-devel \
        gdbm-devel \
        libpcap-devel \
        xz-devel \
        libev-devel \
        expat-devel \
        libffi-devel \
        systemtap-sdt-devel \
    && yum clean all \
    && rm -rf /var/cache/yum \
    && rm -rf /tmp/*

# Install Python
RUN curl -fsSL https://repo.huaweicloud.com/python/3.12.16/Python-3.12.16.tgz -o /tmp/Python-3.12.16.tgz && \
    tar -xf /tmp/Python-3.12.16.tgz -C /tmp && \
    cd /tmp/Python-3.12.16 && \
    mkdir -p /usr/local/python3.12.16/lib && \
    ./configure --enable-shared --enable-shared LDFLAGS="-Wl,-rpath /usr/local/python3.12.16/lib" --prefix=/usr/local/python3.12.16 && \
    make -j $(nproc) && \
    make altinstall && \
    ln -sf /usr/local/python3.12.16/bin/python3.12 /usr/local/python3.12.16/bin/python3 && \
    ln -sf /usr/local/python3.12.16/bin/pip3.12 /usr/local/python3.12.16/bin/pip3 && \
    ln -sf /usr/local/python3.12.16/bin/python3 /usr/local/python3.12.16/bin/python && \
    ln -sf /usr/local/python3.12.16/bin/pip3 /usr/local/python3.12.16/bin/pip && \
    rm -rf /tmp/*

# Stage 2: Install CANN
FROM python-installer AS cann-installer

ARG TARGETPLATFORM

RUN yum update -y && \
    yum install -y \
        unzip \
        pciutils \
        net-tools \
        lapack-devel \
        gcc-gfortran \
        util-linux \
        findutils \
        wget \
    && yum clean all \
    && rm -rf /var/cache/yum

# Note: Install CANN runtime dependencies
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir --upgrade pip
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir \
        attrs cython numpy decorator sympy cffi pyyaml pathlib2 \
        psutil protobuf==3.20 scipy requests absl-py

# Note: Get the download link according to ARCH and download the installation package
RUN ARCH=$(case "${TARGETPLATFORM}" in \
        "linux/amd64") echo "x86_64" ;; \
        "linux/arm64") echo "aarch64" ;; \
        *) echo "Unsupported TARGETPLATFORM: ${TARGETPLATFORM}" && exit 1 ;; \
    esac) && \
    CANN_TOOLKIT_URL=https://ascend-repo.obs.cn-east-2.myhuaweicloud.com/CANN/CANN%209.2.1/Ascend-cann-toolkit_9.2.1_linux-${ARCH}.run && \

    CANN_NNAL_URL=https://ascend-repo.obs.cn-east-2.myhuaweicloud.com/CANN/CANN%209.2.1/Ascend-cann-nnal_9.2.1_linux-${ARCH}.run && \

    wget --quiet --header="Referer: https://www.hiascend.com/" ${CANN_OPS_URL} -O ~/Ascend-cann-ops.run && \
    wget --quiet --header="Referer: https://www.hiascend.com/" ${CANN_NNAL_URL} -O ~/Ascend-cann-nnal.run

RUN chmod +x ~/Ascend-cann-toolkit.run && \
    ~/Ascend-cann-toolkit.run --quiet --install --install-for-all && \
    rm -f ~/Ascend-cann-toolkit.run

# Note: Install CANN Ops Operator Package
RUN chmod +x ~/Ascend-cann-ops.run && \
    ~/Ascend-cann-ops.run --quiet --install --install-for-all && \
    rm -f ~/Ascend-cann-ops.run

# Note: Install CANN NNAL Neural Network Acceleration Library
RUN . /usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/set_env.sh && \
    chmod +x ~/Ascend-cann-nnal.run && \
    ~/Ascend-cann-nnal.run --quiet --install --install-for-all && \
    rm -f ~/Ascend-cann-nnal.run

# ============================================================
# Dockerfile — MindIE multi-stage image
# ============================================================
# Build args drive OS, chip, arch, python, CANN, PTA selection.
# A5 is not supported.
# Usage:
#   docker build --build-arg OS_TYPE=ubuntu --build-arg CHIP=910 \
#     --build-arg ARCH=x86_64 --build-arg PYTHON_VERSION=3.11.10 \
#     ... -f Dockerfile -t mindie:latest downloads/
# ============================================================

ARG OS_TYPE=ubuntu

# ================================================================
# Stage 1a: Ubuntu base (compiled python)
# ================================================================
FROM ubuntu:24.04 AS base-ubuntu

ARG PYTHON_VERSION
ARG PYTHON_MAJOR_VERSION
ARG PYTHON_SHORT_VERSION

# Copy Python source tarball (only dependency needed by base-ubuntu)
COPY downloads/Python-${PYTHON_VERSION}.tar.xz /opt/package/

ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
ENV TZ=Asia/Shanghai
ENV LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/Ascend/driver/lib64/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/lib64/common
ENV LANG=C.UTF-8
ENV PATH=/usr/local/bin:$PATH

RUN sed -i \
        -e 's|http://archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/|http://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/ubuntu/|g' \
        -e 's|http://security.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/|http://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/ubuntu/|g' \
        -e 's|http://ports.ubuntu.com/ubuntu-ports/|http://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/ubuntu-ports/|g' \
        /etc/apt/sources.list.d/ubuntu.sources && \
    apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates && \
    sed -i 's|http://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/|https://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/|g' /etc/apt/sources.list.d/ubuntu.sources && \
    apt-get update && apt-get upgrade -y && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
        ca-certificates netbase tzdata wget vim libjemalloc2 && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# compile python from source
RUN set -eux; \
    savedAptMark="$(apt-mark showmanual)"; \
    apt-get update; \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
        dpkg-dev gcc gnupg libbluetooth-dev libbz2-dev libc6-dev libdb-dev \
        libffi-dev libgdbm-dev liblzma-dev libncursesw5-dev libreadline-dev \
        libsqlite3-dev libssl-dev make tk-dev uuid-dev xz-utils zlib1g-dev; \
    mkdir -p /opt/package /usr/src/python; \
    cd /opt/package; \
    ls -l; \
    tar --extract --directory /usr/src/python --strip-components=1 --file Python-${PYTHON_VERSION}.tar.xz; \
    cd /usr/src/python; \
    gnuArch="$(dpkg-architecture --query DEB_BUILD_GNU_TYPE)"; \
    ./configure \
        --build="$gnuArch" --enable-loadable-sqlite-extensions \
        --enable-optimizations --enable-option-checking=fatal \
        --enable-shared --with-lto --with-ensurepip; \
    EXTRA_CFLAGS="$(dpkg-buildflags --get CFLAGS)"; \
    LDFLAGS="$(dpkg-buildflags --get LDFLAGS)"; \
    LDFLAGS="${LDFLAGS:--Wl},--strip-all"; \
    make -j "$(nproc)" "EXTRA_CFLAGS=${EXTRA_CFLAGS:-}" "LDFLAGS=${LDFLAGS:-}"; \
    rm python; \
    make -j "$(nproc)" "EXTRA_CFLAGS=${EXTRA_CFLAGS:-}" "LDFLAGS=${LDFLAGS:--Wl},-rpath='\$\$ORIGIN/../lib'" python; \
    make install; \
    cd /; rm -rf /usr/src/python; \
    find /usr/local -depth \
        \( \( -type d -a \( -name test -o -name tests -o -name idle_test \) \) \
           -o \( -type f -a \( -name '*.pyc' -o -name '*.pyo' -o -name 'libpython*.a' \) \) \
        \) -exec rm -rf '{}' +; \
    ldconfig; \
    apt-mark auto '.*' > /dev/null; \

# ============================================
# MindSpeed LLM Docker Image
# NPU Type: Configurable (910b, a3, 950)

# ------------------------------

# Switch to root user
USER root

ARG OS_FAMILY=openeuler

# Set default shell to bash
SHELL ["/bin/bash", "-c"]

# Detect architecture (x86_64 or aarch64)
RUN ARCH=$(uname -m) && \
    echo "Detected CPU architecture: ${ARCH}" && \
    if [ "$ARCH" = "x86_64" ]; then \
        echo "Architecture type: x86"; \
    elif [ "$ARCH" = "aarch64" ]; then \
        echo "Architecture type: ARM"; \
    else \
        echo "ERROR: Unsupported architecture: $ARCH"; \
        exit 1; \
    fi

# Configure repository based on OS_FAMILY (openeuler/ubuntu)
COPY configure_repo.sh /tmp/configure_repo.sh
RUN chmod +x /tmp/configure_repo.sh && \
    bash /tmp/configure_repo.sh && \
    rm /tmp/configure_repo.sh

# Install system dependencies
RUN echo "Installing system dependencies..." && \
    if [ "$OS_FAMILY" = "openeuler" ]; then \
        yum install -y \
            git \
            iproute \
            wget \
            curl \
            gcc \
            gcc-c++ \
            make \
            cmake \
        && yum clean all; \
    elif [ "$OS_FAMILY" = "ubuntu" ]; then \
        apt-get install -y \
            git \
            iproute2 \
            wget \
            curl \
            gcc \
            g++ \
            make \
            cmake \
        && apt-get clean \
        && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*; \
    else \
        echo "ERROR: Unsupported OS: $OS_FAMILY"; \
        exit 1; \
    fi

# Ensure CANN built-in Python can compile C++ extensions (e.g. helpers.cpp via Makefile)
# Makefile needs BOTH: Python.h (for pybind11 --includes) and python3-config (for --extension-suffix)
RUN PYTHON_INC=$(python3 -c "import sysconfig; print(sysconfig.get_path('include'))") && \
    echo "Python include path: ${PYTHON_INC}" && \
    HAVE_H=false && HAVE_CFG=false && \
    [ -f "${PYTHON_INC}/Python.h" ] && HAVE_H=true; \
    command -v python3-config >/dev/null 2>&1 && HAVE_CFG=true; \
    echo "Python.h present: ${HAVE_H}, python3-config present: ${HAVE_CFG}" && \
    if [ "$HAVE_H" = false ] || [ "$HAVE_CFG" = false ]; then \
        echo "Installing development headers for CANN built-in Python..." && \
        PYTHON_VER=$(python3 -c "import sys; print(f'{sys.version_info.major}.{sys.version_info.minor}')") && \
        if [ "$OS_FAMILY" = "openeuler" ]; then \
            yum install -y --setopt=sslverify=false python${PYTHON_VER}-devel || yum install -y --setopt=sslverify=false python3-devel; \
            yum clean all; \
        elif [ "$OS_FAMILY" = "ubuntu" ]; then \
            apt-get update -o Acquire::https::Verify-Peer=false -o Acquire::https::Verify-Host=false && \
            apt-get install -y -o Acquire::https::Verify-Peer=false -o Acquire::https::Verify-Host=false python${PYTHON_VER}-dev || \
            apt-get install -y -o Acquire::https::Verify-Peer=false -o Acquire::https::Verify-Host=false python3-dev; \
            apt-get clean && \
            rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*; \
        fi; \
    else \
        echo "CANN built-in Python already provides Python.h and python3-config"; \
    fi && \
    echo "Verifying build prerequisites:" && \
    ls "${PYTHON_INC}/Python.h" && \
    python3-config --extension-suffix

# ------------------------------
# Stage 2: Builder (Python env + PyTorch)
# ------------------------------
FROM base AS builder

ARG TORCH_VERSION=2.7.1
ARG TORCH_NPU_VERSION=2.7.1.post8
ARG TRITON_ASCEND_VERSION=3.2.2

RUN pip config set global.index-url https://repo.huaweicloud.com/repository/pypi/simple

# Install PyTorch and torch_npu (ONLINE INSTALL ONLY)
RUN echo "Installing PyTorch and torch_npu from PyPI..." && \
        ARCH=$(uname -m) && \
        MAX_RETRIES=3 && \
        for retry in $(seq 1 $MAX_RETRIES); do \
            echo ">>> Attempt $retry of $MAX_RETRIES"; \
            pip cache purge 2>/dev/null || true; \
            rm -rf /root/.cache/pip; \
            if [ "$ARCH" = "x86_64" ]; then \
                echo "Installing PyTorch for x86_64..." && \
                pip install --no-cache-dir torch==${TORCH_VERSION} torchvision torchaudio --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu && break; \
            elif [ "$ARCH" = "aarch64" ]; then \
                echo "Installing PyTorch for aarch64..." && \
                pip install --no-cache-dir torch==${TORCH_VERSION} torchvision torchaudio && break; \
            fi; \
        done && \
        for retry in $(seq 1 $MAX_RETRIES); do \
            echo ">>> Installing torch-npu, attempt $retry of $MAX_RETRIES"; \
            pip cache purge 2>/dev/null || true; \
            rm -rf /root/.cache/pip; \
            pip install --no-cache-dir torch-npu==${TORCH_NPU_VERSION} && break; \
        done;

# Install Triton-Ascend
RUN echo "Installing Triton-Ascend..." && \
    mkdir -p /tmp/triton-ascend && \
    pip download --no-cache-dir --no-deps \
        triton-ascend==${TRITON_ASCEND_VERSION} \
        --index-url=https://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/ascend/repos/pypi \
        --dest /tmp/triton-ascend && \
    pip install --no-cache-dir /tmp/triton-ascend/triton_ascend-*.whl && \
    rm -rf /tmp/triton-ascend

# Clean pip cache
RUN pip cache purge

# ------------------------------
# Stage 3: Final Runtime Image
# ------------------------------
FROM builder AS final

# Arguments for MindSpeed-LLM
ARG MINDSPEED_LLM_BRANCH=26.1.0
ARG MINDSPEED_BRANCH=26.1.0_core_r0.12.1

        apt-get update && \

    elif command -v yum >/dev/null 2>&1; then \
        yum install -y patch gawk && \
        yum clean all; \
    else \
        echo "No supported package manager found"; \

    fi

RUN python -m pip install --no-cache-dir PyYAML

RUN git clone https://github.com/flashserve/flash-linear-attention-npu.git && \
    cd flash-linear-attention-npu && \
    git checkout ${FLASH_LINEAR_ATTENTION_NPU_BRANCH}

RUN cd flash-linear-attention-npu && \
    if [ -f /usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/set_env.sh ]; then \
        source /usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/set_env.sh; \
    elif [ -f /usr/local/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh ]; then \
        source /usr/local/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh; \
    else \

    bash build.sh --soc=${FLA_NPU_SOC} --pkg --ops=${FLA_NPU_OPS} && \
    ./build_out/cann-*.run && \
    cd torch_custom/fla_npu && \
    bash build.sh

# Install MindSpeed
RUN git clone https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed.git && \
    cd MindSpeed && \

label: Dockerfile
content:
# ============================================
# MindSpeed MM Docker Image Build File (dev image)
#
# Supported NPU types:        910b, a3, 950
# Supported CPU architectures: x86_64 and aarch64 (ARM)
# Supported operating systems: openEuler and Ubuntu
#
# Multi-stage build:
#   Stage 1 (base):            system runtime deps, Miniconda, PyTorch, torch_npu,
#                              decord (x86_64 via pip)
#   Stage 2 (decord-builder):  build decord + ffmpeg from source (aarch64 only)
#   Stage 3 (final):           assemble runtime artifacts, clone MindSpeed-MM
#
# The CI image is built separately on top of this dev image (see Dockerfile.ci).
# ============================================

ARG BASE_IMAGE=""
FROM ${BASE_IMAGE:-swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/cann:9.1.0-a3-openeuler24.03-py3.11} AS base

# The CANN base image defaults to a non-root user
USER root

# --- Build arguments (base stage) ---
ARG MINICONDA_SH
ARG TORCH_VERSION=2.7.1
ARG TORCH_NPU_VERSION=2.7.1.post8
ARG PYTHON_VERSION=3.11

# Print CPU architecture (x86_64 / aarch64) for early feedback.
RUN ARCH=$(uname -m) && \
    echo "==========================================" && \
    echo "Detected CPU architecture: ${ARCH}" && \
    case "$ARCH" in \
        x86_64|aarch64) echo "Architecture supported" ;; \
        *) echo "ERROR: Unsupported architecture: $ARCH"; exit 1 ;; \
    esac && \
    echo "=========================================="

# Configure system package repositories (external script handles yum/apt sources).
# Kept early in the build: this layer only changes when the script changes, so
# the layers below it are reused from cache across builds.
COPY configure_repo.sh /tmp/configure_repo.sh
RUN chmod +x /tmp/configure_repo.sh && \
    bash /tmp/configure_repo.sh && \
    rm /tmp/configure_repo.sh

# Install runtime system dependencies only.
# Build-only toolchain (gcc/g++/make/cmake/autoconf/...) is intentionally NOT
# installed here: it is needed only by the decord-builder stage for aarch64.
# This keeps this stage and the final image smaller. The OS family is detected
# from /etc/os-release, so no build arg is required.
RUN . /etc/os-release && \
    ID_LOWER=$(echo "$ID" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]') && \
    case "$ID_LOWER" in \
        *openeuler*) \
            yum install -y git iproute wget curl vim gawk ffmpeg && \
            yum clean all ;; \
        *ubuntu*) \
            apt-get install -y git iproute2 wget curl vim gawk ffmpeg \
                libavcodec-dev libavformat-dev libavutil-dev libswscale-dev && \
            apt-get clean ;; \
        *) echo "ERROR: Unsupported OS ID: $ID" && exit 1 ;; \
    esac

# Install Miniconda. The installer variant (py3xx) is selected by
# --python-version, which sets the Python version of the conda base environment.
# -b: silent install (no user prompts); -p /opt/conda: target install path.
COPY ${MINICONDA_SH} /tmp/miniconda.sh
RUN bash /tmp/miniconda.sh -b -p /opt/conda && \
    rm /tmp/miniconda.sh && \
    export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH && \
    # conda 25.x requires accepting the Anaconda channel ToS before installing.
    conda tos accept --override-channels --channel https://repo.anaconda.com/pkgs/main && \
    conda tos accept --override-channels --channel https://repo.anaconda.com/pkgs/r && \
    # Pin the conda base environment to the requested Python version
    conda install -y -n base python=${PYTHON_VERSION} && \
    conda clean -ya

ENV PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
ENV CONDA_AUTO_UPDATE_CONDA=false

# Configure pip to use the Huawei Cloud PyPI mirror and init conda for bash
# (auto-activates the base env on container start).
RUN pip config set global.index-url https://repo.huaweicloud.com/repository/pypi/simple && \
    pip config set global.trusted-host "repo.huaweicloud.com" && \
    /opt/conda/bin/conda init bash

# Install PyTorch and torch_npu (online). Retries tolerate network instability.
# - x86_64:  official PyTorch CPU index (more stable).
# - aarch64: default PyPI index.
RUN ARCH=$(uname -m) && \
    MAX_RETRIES=3 && \
    for retry in $(seq 1 $MAX_RETRIES); do \
        pip cache purge 2>/dev/null || true; \
        rm -rf /root/.cache/pip; \
        if [ "$ARCH" = "x86_64" ]; then \
            if pip install --no-cache-dir torch==${TORCH_VERSION} torchvision torchaudio --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu; then break; fi; \
        elif [ "$ARCH" = "aarch64" ]; then \
            if pip install --no-cache-dir torch==${TORCH_VERSION} torchvision torchaudio; then break; fi; \
        fi; \
    done && \
    for retry in $(seq 1 $MAX_RETRIES); do \
        pip cache purge 2>/dev/null || true; \
        rm -rf /root/.cache/pip; \
        if pip install --no-cache-dir torch-npu==${TORCH_NPU_VERSION} pyyaml; then break; fi; \
    done

# Install decord via pip on x86_64 (on aarch64 it is built from source in the
# decord-builder stage).
RUN ARCH=$(uname -m) && \
    if [ "$ARCH" = "x86_64" ]; then \
        for retry in $(seq 1 3); do \
            pip cache purge 2>/dev/null || true; \
            rm -rf /root/.cache/pip; \
            if pip install --no-cache-dir decord==0.6.0; then break; fi; \
        done; \
    fi

# ========================================
# Stage 2 (decord-builder): aarch64 only.
# Builds ffmpeg + decord from source and collects the runtime artifacts into
# /decord_artifacts, so the final image does not retain build tools or sources.
# ========================================
FROM base AS decord-builder

ARG DECORD_SCRIPT
ARG DECORD_DEPS_DIR=decord_deps
ARG DECORD_BUILD=false

COPY ${DECORD_SCRIPT} /tmp/install_decord.sh
COPY ${DECORD_DEPS_DIR} /tmp/decord_deps/

RUN chmod +x /tmp/install_decord.sh && \
    ARCH=$(uname -m) && \
    mkdir -p /decord_artifacts/lib /decord_artifacts/site && \
    if [ "$ARCH" = "aarch64" ] && [ "$DECORD_BUILD" = "true" ]; then \
        echo "Building decord for aarch64..." && \
        bash /tmp/install_decord.sh /tmp/decord_deps && \
        echo "Collecting decord runtime artifacts..." && \

# ============================================================
# MindStudio Insight -- Minimal Single-Container Image
# Base: openeuler/openeuler:24.03-lts
# ============================================================

ARG VERSION=26.2.0
ARG TAG=26.2.0

# ============================================================
# Stage 1: Download & extract (discarded after copy)
# ============================================================
FROM openeuler/openeuler:24.03-lts AS downloader

RUN dnf install -y wget ca-certificates unzip coreutils \
    && dnf clean all \
    && rm -rf /var/cache/dnf

ARG TARGETARCH
ARG VERSION
ARG TAG

WORKDIR /downloads

RUN set -ex; \
    if [ "$TARGETARCH" = "arm64" ]; then \
        INSIGHT_ARCH="aarch64"; \
    elif [ "$TARGETARCH" = "amd64" ]; then \
        INSIGHT_ARCH="x86_64"; \
    else \
        echo "ERROR: Unsupported architecture '$TARGETARCH'. Only amd64 and arm64 are supported." >&2; \
        exit 1; \
    fi; \
    echo "Architecture: $TARGETARCH"; \
    echo "Version:      $VERSION"; \
    echo "Tag:          $TAG"; \
    INSIGHT_URL="https://gitcode.com/Ascend/msinsight/releases/download/tag_MindStudio_${TAG}/MindStudio-Insight_${VERSION}_linux_${INSIGHT_ARCH}.zip"; \
    echo "Download URL: $INSIGHT_URL"; \
    wget -q -O insight-package.zip "${INSIGHT_URL}"; \
    wget -q -O insight-package.zip.sha256 "${INSIGHT_URL}.sha256"; \
    EXPECTED_HASH=$(awk '{print $1}' insight-package.zip.sha256); \
    ACTUAL_HASH=$(sha256sum insight-package.zip | awk '{print $1}'); \
    if [ "$EXPECTED_HASH" != "$ACTUAL_HASH" ]; then \
        echo "ERROR: SHA256 mismatch!" >&2; \
        echo "  Expected: $EXPECTED_HASH" >&2; \
        echo "  Actual:   $ACTUAL_HASH" >&2; \
        exit 1; \
    fi; \
    echo "SHA256 verified: $ACTUAL_HASH"; \
    rm -f insight-package.zip.sha256; \
    unzip -q insight-package.zip; \
    rm -f insight-package.zip

# ============================================================
# Stage 2: Minimal runtime image
# ============================================================
FROM openeuler/openeuler:24.03-lts AS runtime

ARG VERSION
ARG TAG
ARG TARGETARCH

ENV ASCEND_SOFTWARE_VERSION=${VERSION}

LABEL org.opencontainers.image.title="MindStudio Insight" \
      org.opencontainers.image.description="All-scenario Ascend AI visualization profiling tool" \
      org.opencontainers.image.version="${VERSION}" \
      org.opencontainers.image.vendor="Ascend/MindStudio" \
      org.opencontainers.image.authors="MindStudio Team" \
      org.opencontainers.image.source="https://gitcode.com/Ascend/msinsight" \
      org.opencontainers.image.url="https://www.hiascend.com/developer/ascendhub" \
      org.opencontainers.image.licenses="MulanPSL2" \
      org.opencontainers.image.ref.name="MindStudio_${TAG}" \
      org.opencontainers.image.architecture="${TARGETARCH}"

# ---- Install only runtime dependencies ----
RUN dnf install -y \
        nginx \
        supervisor \
        curl \
        openssl \
        lsof \
        python3 \
        python3-pip \
    && dnf clean all \
    && rm -rf /var/cache/dnf /usr/share/doc /usr/share/man /usr/share/locale

# ---- Create application directories ----
RUN mkdir -p /opt/insight/backend /opt/insight/python-scripts /opt/insight/data \
    /var/log/supervisor /etc/nginx/templates /etc/nginx/conf.d \
    /run/nginx /var/lib/nginx/tmp

# ---- Copy artifacts from Stage 1 ----
# Zip structure after unzip:
#   resources/profiler/frontend/  -> nginx static files
#   resources/profiler/server/    -> C++ binary (profiler_server) + libs
#   resources/profiler/scripts/   -> Python scripts + requirements.txt
COPY --from=downloader /downloads/resources/profiler/frontend/ /usr/share/nginx/html/
COPY --from=downloader /downloads/resources/profiler/server/  /opt/insight/backend/
COPY --from=downloader /downloads/resources/profiler/scripts/ /opt/insight/python-scripts/

# ---- Fix permissions (zip may strip world-readable bits) ----
RUN chmod -R o+rX /usr/share/nginx/html/

# ---- Make backend binary executable ----
RUN chmod +x /opt/insight/backend/profiler_server 2>/dev/null || true

# ---- Copy local configuration files ----
COPY nginx.conf       /etc/nginx/templates/nginx.conf
COPY nginx-http.conf  /etc/nginx/templates/nginx-http.conf
COPY ws-map.conf      /etc/nginx/conf.d/ws-map.conf
COPY supervisord.conf /etc/supervisord.d/insight.ini
COPY entrypoint.sh    /entrypoint.sh
COPY requirements.txt /opt/insight/python-scripts/requirements.txt

RUN chmod +x /entrypoint.sh

# ---- Install Python dependencies ----
RUN pip3 install --no-cache-dir --index-url https://mirrors.aliyun.com/pypi/simple/ -r /opt/insight/python-scripts/requirements.txt

# ---- Expose HTTPS and HTTP ports ----
EXPOSE 443
EXPOSE 80

# ---- Health check ----
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=5s --start-period=10s --retries=3 \
    CMD (curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:8080/health || curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:80/health) \
        && pgrep -x profiler_server >/dev/null \
        && lsof -Pan -iTCP:9000 -sTCP:LISTEN >/dev/null \
        || exit 1

# ---- Entrypoint ----
ENTRYPOINT ["/entrypoint.sh"]
CMD ["/usr/bin/supervisord", "-n", "-c", "/etc/supervisord.conf"]

ARG OS=openeuler24.03
ARG BASE_IMAGE_VERSION=9.1.0
ARG NPU_TYPE=910b

ARG BASE_IMAGE=""

ARG OS_FAMILY=openeuler

ARG MEGATRON_BRANCH=core_v0.12.1

    bash /tmp/configure_repo.sh && \

    echo "Detected CPU architecture: ${ARCH}" && \

RUN echo "Installing system dependencies for ${OS_FAMILY}..." && \

            build-essential \
            cmake \
            curl \
            gcc \
            g++ \
            git \
            jq \
            libnuma-dev \
            vim \
            wget && \
        apt-get clean && \

            cmake \
            curl \
            findutils \
            gcc \
            gcc-c++ \
            git \
            jq \
            make \
            numactl-devel \
            tar \
            vim \
            wget \

        yum clean all && \

    rm -rf /tmp/* /var/tmp/* && \

    git clone https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM.git && \

    if [ "$ARCH" = "x86_64" ]; then \

    fi && \

    if [ -n "$DEVLIB_DIR" ]; then \
        export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="${DEVLIB_DIR}:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH}"; \
    fi && \
    source /usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/set_env.sh && \
    if [ -f /usr/local/Ascend/nnal/atb/set_env.sh ]; then \
        source /usr/local/Ascend/nnal/atb/set_env.sh; \
    fi && \
    pip install torch==${TORCH_VERSION} torch_npu==${TORCH_NPU_VERSION} && \
    pip install -r /MindSpeed/requirements.txt && \

    pip install -e /Megatron-LM && \

        torch==${TORCH_VERSION} \
        torch_npu==${TORCH_NPU_VERSION} \

    python -c "from importlib.metadata import version; from packaging.version import Version; expected = {'torch': '${TORCH_VERSION}', 'torch_npu': '${TORCH_NPU_VERSION}', 'numpy': '${NUMPY_VERSION}'}; actual = {name: version(name) for name in expected}; mismatched = {name: (expected[name], actual[name]) for name in expected if Version(actual[name]).public != Version(expected[name]).public}; assert not mismatched, f'Version mismatch: {mismatched}'; print(f'Pinned versions verified: {actual}')" && \
    rm -rf /tmp/* /var/tmp/* && \
    pip cache purge

ENV PYTHONPATH="/Megatron-LM${PYTHONPATH:+:${PYTHONPATH}}"

# Show install results

CMD ["/bin/bash"]

# please configure and use a base image as appropriate
# Base image uses OpenEuler 22.03
FROM openeuler/openeuler:22.03-lts-sp4
WORKDIR /tmp

# Replace the official OpenEuler repositories with Huawei Cloud mirrors (modify as needed)
RUN sed -i 's|http://repo.openeuler.org|https://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/openeuler|g' /etc/yum.repos.d/*.repo && \
    sed -i 's|http://mirrors.openeuler.org|https://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/openeuler|g' /etc/yum.repos.d/*.repo

# 1. Install system dependencies (cache this layer)
RUN dnf install -y -q ca-certificates && \
    dnf makecache -q && \
    dnf -y -q install net-tools make wget unzip zlib-devel bzip2 bzip2-devel openssl-devel \
    ncurses-devel openssh-clients openssh-server sqlite-devel \
    readline-devel tk-devel gdbm-devel libdb-devel xz-devel libffi-devel \
    hdf5-devel patch pciutils vim findutils util-linux  dos2unix gcc-c++ automake autoconf \
    m4 perl git e2fsprogs sudo && \
    dnf clean all && \
    rm -rf /var/cache/dnf

# Note: openssh-server is required by the two-node training sample and can be removed for single-node training
RUN mkdir -p /usr/local/gcc11.2.0
# 2. Build and install GCC 11.2.0 (download -> build -> clean up in the same layer)
# Workflow: download GCC source -> download 4 dependency libraries (gmp/mpfr/mpc/isl) -> configure -> make -> install -> replace system libstdc++ -> clean up
RUN wget -q https://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/gnu/gcc/gcc-11.2.0/gcc-11.2.0.tar.gz && \
    tar -zxf gcc-11.2.0.tar.gz && \
    cd gcc-11.2.0 && \
    # Download the 4 math dependency libraries required to build GCC
    wget -q https://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/gnu/gmp/gmp-6.1.0.tar.bz2 && \
    wget -q https://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/gnu/mpfr/mpfr-3.1.6.tar.bz2 && \
    wget -q https://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/gnu/mpc/mpc-1.0.3.tar.gz && \
    wget -q https://gcc.gnu.org/pub/gcc/infrastructure/isl-0.18.tar.bz2 && \
    # Fix the tar owner issue when extracting in the download_prerequisites script (root inside Docker needs --no-same-owner)
    sed -i "246s/tar -xf \"\${ar}\"/tar --no-same-owner -xf \"\${ar}\"/" contrib/download_prerequisites && \
    ./contrib/download_prerequisites && \
    ./configure --enable-languages=c,c++ --disable-multilib --with-system-zlib --disable-bootstrap --prefix=/usr/local/gcc11.2.0 > /dev/null && \
    make -j $(nproc) && make install && \
    # Copy the new libstdc++.so.6.0.29 into the system library directory so programs built later link against the new C++ standard library
    find /tmp/gcc-11.2.0/ -name libstdc++.so.6.0.29 -exec cp {} /lib64/ \; && \
    rm -rf /tmp/gcc-11.2.0*

ENV LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/gcc11.2.0/lib64:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH \
    PATH=/usr/local/gcc11.2.0/bin:$PATH

# 3. Install cmake-3.22.6 (download -> build -> clean up in the same layer)
RUN wget -q https://cmake.org/files/v3.22/cmake-3.22.6.tar.gz && \
    . /etc/profile && gcc -v && tar -zxf /tmp/cmake-3.22.6.tar.gz && \
    cd cmake-3.22.6 && \
    ./bootstrap > /dev/null && make -j $(nproc) && make install && \
    rm -rf /tmp/cmake-3.22.6*

# 4. Install python3.7.5 (download -> build -> clean up in the same layer)
RUN wget -q https://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/python/3.7.5/Python-3.7.5.tar.xz && \
    . /etc/profile && gcc -v && tar -xf /tmp/Python-3.7.5.tar.xz && \
    cd Python-3.7.5 && \
    mkdir -p build && cd build && \
    ../configure --enable-shared --prefix=/usr/local/python3.7.5 > /dev/null && \
    make -j $(nproc) && make install && \
    rm -rf /tmp/Python-3.7.5* && \
    ldconfig

ENV PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/python3.7.5/bin \
    LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$LD_LIBRARY_PATH:/usr/local/python3.7.5/lib

RUN ln -sf /usr/local/python3.7.5/bin/python3 /usr/bin/python3 && \
    ln -sf /usr/local/python3.7.5/bin/python3 /usr/bin/python && \
    ln -sf /usr/local/python3.7.5/bin/pip3 /usr/bin/pip3 && \
    ln -sf /usr/local/python3.7.5/bin/pip3 /usr/bin/pip

# 4.1 Install hdf5 and h5py (download -> build -> clean up in the same layer)
RUN wget -q https://support.hdfgroup.org/ftp/HDF5/releases/hdf5-1.10/hdf5-1.10.5/src/hdf5-1.10.5.tar.gz && \
    tar -zxf hdf5-1.10.5.tar.gz && \
    cd hdf5-1.10.5 && \
    ./configure --prefix=/usr/local/hdf5 --enable-shared --enable-hl > /dev/null && \
    make -j $(nproc) && make install && cd .. && rm -rf hdf5-1.10.5*

RUN echo "/usr/local/hdf5/lib" > /etc/ld.so.conf.d/hdf5.conf && ldconfig
ENV HDF5_DIR=/usr/local/hdf5 \
PATH=/usr/local/hdf5/bin:$PATH

ENV CPATH=/usr/local/hdf5/include/:/usr/local/hdf5/lib/
ENV LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/hdf5/lib/:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH

RUN ARCH=$(uname -m) && \
    if [ "$ARCH" = "x86_64" ]; then \
        mkdir -p /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu && \
        ln -s /usr/local/hdf5/lib/libhdf5.so /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libhdf5.so && \
        ln -s /usr/local/hdf5/lib/libhdf5_hl.so /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libhdf5_hl.so; \
    else \
        mkdir -p /usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu && \
        ln -s /usr/local/hdf5/lib/libhdf5.so /usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/libhdf5.so && \
        ln -s /usr/local/hdf5/lib/libhdf5_hl.so /usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/libhdf5_hl.so; \
    fi

# Build and install h5py (download -> build -> clean up in the same layer)
RUN wget -q https://github.com/h5py/h5py/archive/refs/tags/3.1.0.zip -O h5py-3.1.0.zip && \
    mkdir -p /tmp/wheels && \
    pip3.7 install --quiet -U pip && \
    pip3.7 install --quiet "Cython<3" wheel && \
    unzip h5py-3.1.0.zip && \
    cd h5py-3.1.0 && \
    HDF5_DIR=/usr/local/hdf5 python3.7 setup.py bdist_wheel -v && \
    cp dist/*.whl /tmp/wheels/ && \
    pip3.7 install --quiet /tmp/wheels/h5py-3.1.0-*.whl -v && \
    cd .. && rm -rf h5py-3.1.0*

# 4.2 Build and install openmpi (consistent with the Ubuntu image: build from source into the fixed prefix /usr/local/openmpi so the mpicc path is not unpredictable when relying on dnf openmpi-devel)
RUN wget -q https://download.open-mpi.org/release/open-mpi/v4.1/openmpi-4.1.5.tar.gz && \
    . /etc/profile && gcc -v && tar -zxf openmpi-4.1.5.tar.gz && \
    cd openmpi-4.1.5 && \
    ./configure --enable-orterun-prefix-by-default --prefix=/usr/local/openmpi CFLAGS="-fPIC" CXXFLAGS="-fPIC" > /dev/null && \
    make -j $(nproc) && make install && cd .. && \
    rm -rf openmpi-4.1.5*

# 4.3 Permanently add the openmpi library path to the system dynamic linker cache
RUN echo "/usr/local/openmpi/lib" > /etc/ld.so.conf.d/openmpi.conf && ldconfig

ENV LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/openmpi/lib:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH \
    PATH=/usr/local/openmpi/bin:$PATH

# 5. Set the driver path environment variables
ARG ASCEND_BASE=/usr/local/Ascend
ENV LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$ASCEND_BASE/driver/lib64:$ASCEND_BASE/driver/lib64/common:$ASCEND_BASE/driver/lib64/driver:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH

# 6. Define the target core type (a2/a3/a5), specified at build time via --build-arg CORE_TYPE=a2
ARG CORE_TYPE=a2
# Convert it to an ENV variable: every RUN step and child process (pip -> setup.py) can read it directly, and the value persists at container runtime
ENV CORE_TYPE=${CORE_TYPE}

# 7. Download and install the CANN packages (download -> install -> clean up in one layer; install only one set based on CORE_TYPE)
# Workflow: download toolkit -> choose the ops package based on CORE_TYPE -> install to the default path /usr/local/Ascend -> remove the .run files
# CORE_TYPE mapping: a2 -> 910b-ops, a3 -> A3-ops, a5 -> 950-ops
RUN ARCH=$(uname -m) && \
    TOOLKIT_URL_PREFIX="https://ascend-repo.obs.cn-east-2.myhuaweicloud.com/CANN/CANN%209.1.T6" && \
    TOOLKIT_SUFFIX="9.1.0-beta.3_linux-${ARCH}.run" && \
    TOOLKIT_URL="${TOOLKIT_URL_PREFIX}/Ascend-cann-toolkit_${TOOLKIT_SUFFIX}" && \
    wget -q "$TOOLKIT_URL" && \
    # Choose the corresponding ops package based on CORE_TYPE
    case "${CORE_TYPE}" in \
      a2|A2) \
        OPS_URL="${TOOLKIT_URL_PREFIX}/Ascend-cann-910b-ops_${TOOLKIT_SUFFIX}" ;; \
      a3|A3) \
        OPS_URL="${TOOLKIT_URL_PREFIX}/Ascend-cann-A3-ops_${TOOLKIT_SUFFIX}" ;; \
      a5|A5) \
        OPS_URL="${TOOLKIT_URL_PREFIX}/Ascend-cann-950-ops_${TOOLKIT_SUFFIX}" ;; \
      *) \
        echo "ERROR: Unknown CORE_TYPE=${CORE_TYPE}, must be a2/a3/a5" ; exit 1 ;; \
    esac && \
    wget -q "$OPS_URL" && \
    # Silently install toolkit and ops to the default path /usr/local/Ascend
    chmod +x Ascend-cann-toolkit_*.run && \
    bash Ascend-cann-toolkit_9.1.0*.run --quiet --install && \
    chmod +x Ascend-cann-*ops*.run && \
    bash Ascend-cann-*ops*.run --quiet --install && \
    # Clean up the installers
    rm -f Ascend-cann-*.run

# 8. Configure the Python package index
RUN mkdir -p ~/.pip && touch ~/.pip/pip.conf && \
    echo "[global]" > ~/.pip/pip.conf && \
    echo "trusted-host=mirrors.aliyun.com" >> ~/.pip/pip.conf && \
    echo "index-url=http://mirrors.aliyun.com/pypi/simple/" >> ~/.pip/pip.conf && \
    echo "timeout=200" >> ~/.pip/pip.conf

# 9. Download TF/NPU/RecSDK packages -> install -> clean up (all in one layer to avoid intermediate layers wasting space)
# Workflow: download 5 packages per architecture -> create the tf1_env venv (TF1.15) -> create the tf2_env venv (TF2.6) -> install npu packages with system pip -> clean up
# Each venv installs its own TF + NPU packages, and system pip also installs the npu packages for direct use
RUN ARCH=$(uname -m) && \
    # === 1. Download TF/NPU/RecSDK packages by architecture ===
    if [ "$ARCH" = "x86_64" ]; then \
        wget -q https://ascend-repo.obs.cn-east-2.myhuaweicloud.com/MindX/OpenSource/python/packages/tensorflow-1.15.0-cp37-cp37m-manylinux2010_x86_64.whl && \
        wget -q https://ascend-repo.obs.cn-east-2.myhuaweicloud.com/MindX/OpenSource/python/packages/tensorflow-2.6.5-cp37-cp37m-manylinux2010_x86_64.whl && \
        wget -q https://gitcode.com/cann/tensorflow/releases/download/tfa_v0.0.48_9.0.0/npu_bridge-1.15.0-py3-none-manylinux2014_x86_64.whl && \
        wget -q https://gitcode.com/cann/tensorflow/releases/download/tfa_v0.0.48_9.0.0/npu_device-2.6.5-py3-none-manylinux2014_x86_64.whl && \
        wget -q https://mindcluster.obs.cn-north-4.myhuaweicloud.com/newRecSDK/daily/version/26.1.0/20260720.8/tf_rec_v1-26.1.0-linux_x86_64.tar.gz; \
    elif [ "$ARCH" = "aarch64" ]; then \
        wget -q https://ascend-repo.obs.cn-east-2.myhuaweicloud.com/MindX/OpenSource/python/packages/tensorflow-1.15.0-cp37-cp37m-manylinux2014_aarch64.whl && \
        wget -q https://ascend-repo.obs.cn-east-2.myhuaweicloud.com/MindX/OpenSource/python/packages/tensorflow-2.6.5-cp37-cp37m-manylinux2014_aarch64.whl && \
        wget -q https://gitcode.com/cann/tensorflow/releases/download/tfa_v0.0.48_9.0.0/npu_bridge-1.15.0-py3-none-manylinux2014_aarch64.whl && \
        wget -q https://gitcode.com/cann/tensorflow/releases/download/tfa_v0.0.48_9.0.0/npu_device-2.6.5-py3-none-manylinux2014_aarch64.whl && \
        wget -q https://mindcluster.obs.cn-north-4.myhuaweicloud.com/newRecSDK/daily/version/26.1.0/20260720.8/tf_rec_v1-26.1.0-linux_aarch64.tar.gz; \
    else \
        echo "Error: Unsupported architecture '$ARCH'. Only x86_64 and aarch64 are supported." && exit 1; \
    fi && \
    # === 2. Create tf1_env (TF 1.15 + npu_bridge) ===
    # openmpi is built from source into the fixed prefix /usr/local/openmpi, so the mpicc/mpicxx paths definitely exist
    export CC=/usr/local/openmpi/bin/mpicc && \
    export CXX=/usr/local/openmpi/bin/mpicxx && \
    python3.7 -m venv /opt/buildtools/tf1_env && \
    /opt/buildtools/tf1_env/bin/pip install --quiet -U pip && \
    /opt/buildtools/tf1_env/bin/pip install --quiet /tmp/wheels/h5py-3.1.0-*.whl && \
    if [ "$ARCH" = "x86_64" ]; then \
        /opt/buildtools/tf1_env/bin/pip install --quiet tensorflow-1.15.0-cp37-cp37m-manylinux2010_x86_64.whl && \
        /opt/buildtools/tf1_env/bin/pip install --quiet npu_bridge-1.15.0-py3-none-manylinux2014_x86_64.whl; \
    else \
        /opt/buildtools/tf1_env/bin/pip install --quiet tensorflow-1.15.0-cp37-cp37m-manylinux2014_aarch64.whl && \
        /opt/buildtools/tf1_env/bin/pip install --quiet npu_bridge-1.15.0-py3-none-manylinux2014_aarch64.whl; \
    fi && \
    /opt/buildtools/tf1_env/bin/pip install --quiet tf_slim mpi4py && \
    # Source the CANN environment before installing tf_rec_v1 to provide ASCEND_OPP_PATH so operators install correctly
    . /usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/set_env.sh && \
    # CORE_TYPE is already injected via ENV; setup.py reads it through os.environ to control operator compilation for A2/A3/A5
    /opt/buildtools/tf1_env/bin/pip install --quiet --no-build-isolation /tmp/tf_rec_v1*.tar.gz && \
    # A failed horovod install inside setup.py is silently ignored; on openEuler images it must be installed explicitly
    HOROVOD_WITH_MPI=1 HOROVOD_WITH_TENSORFLOW=1 /opt/buildtools/tf1_env/bin/pip install --quiet horovod==0.22.1 --no-cache-dir && \
    # === 3. Create tf2_env (TF 2.6 + npu_device) ===
    python3.7 -m venv /opt/buildtools/tf2_env && \
    /opt/buildtools/tf2_env/bin/pip install --quiet -U pip && \
    /opt/buildtools/tf2_env/bin/pip install --quiet /tmp/wheels/h5py-3.1.0-*.whl && \
    if [ "$ARCH" = "x86_64" ]; then \
        /opt/buildtools/tf2_env/bin/pip install --quiet tensorflow-2.6.5-cp37-cp37m-manylinux2010_x86_64.whl && \
        /opt/buildtools/tf2_env/bin/pip install --quiet npu_device-2.6.5-py3-none-manylinux2014_x86_64.whl; \
    else \
        /opt/buildtools/tf2_env/bin/pip install --quiet tensorflow-2.6.5-cp37-cp37m-manylinux2014_aarch64.whl && \
        /opt/buildtools/tf2_env/bin/pip install --quiet npu_device-2.6.5-py3-none-manylinux2014_aarch64.whl; \
    fi && \
    /opt/buildtools/tf2_env/bin/pip install --quiet tf_slim mpi4py && \
    # Source the CANN environment before installing tf_rec_v1 to provide ASCEND_OPP_PATH so operators install correctly
    . /usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/set_env.sh && \
    # CORE_TYPE is already injected via ENV; setup.py reads it through os.environ to control operator compilation for A2/A3/A5
    /opt/buildtools/tf2_env/bin/pip install --quiet --no-build-isolation /tmp/tf_rec_v1*.tar.gz && \
    # A failed horovod install inside setup.py is silently ignored; on openEuler images it must be installed explicitly
    HOROVOD_WITH_MPI=1 HOROVOD_WITH_TENSORFLOW=1 /opt/buildtools/tf2_env/bin/pip install --quiet horovod==0.22.1 --no-cache-dir && \
    # === 4. Install npu packages with system pip (for direct use outside venvs) ===
    pip3.7 install --quiet -U pip && \
    if [ "$ARCH" = "x86_64" ]; then \
        pip3.7 install --quiet npu_bridge-1.15.0-py3-none-manylinux2014_x86_64.whl --force-reinstall && \
        pip3.7 install --quiet npu_device-2.6.5-py3-none-manylinux2014_x86_64.whl --force-reinstall; \
    else \
        pip3.7 install --quiet npu_bridge-1.15.0-py3-none-manylinux2014_aarch64.whl --force-reinstall && \
        pip3.7 install --quiet npu_device-2.6.5-py3-none-manylinux2014_aarch64.whl --force-reinstall; \
    fi && \
    pip3.7 install --quiet packaging numpy && \
    # === 5. Clean up the pip cache and all downloaded temporary files ===
    rm -rf /root/.cache/pip && \
    rm -rf /tmp/*

WORKDIR /home

# Set the variables required by the script
ENV ASCEND_SOFTWARE_NAME="RecSDK"
ENV ASCEND_SOFTWARE_VERSION="26.1.0"

COPY scripts/banner.sh /usr/local/bin/banner.sh
RUN chmod +x /usr/local/bin/banner.sh

ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/local/bin/banner.sh"]
CMD ["/bin/bash"]
